exposure: combined spinal-epidural (CSE) analgesia for labor pain relief
outcome: cervical dilatation at initiation of analgesia
cohort: 30 parturients (21 nulliparous and 9 parous) with a singleton gestation in labor
finding: The study found that CSE analgesia was safe and effective for labor pain relief in both nulliparous and parous women, with high rates of adequate analgesia and spontaneous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: While 76.7% of the cohort had a spontaneous vaginal delivery, only nulliparous participants (23.3%) underwent cesarean delivery, although this difference was not statistically significant (P=0.07).
